notes.title: Me && MORY is available + additional info!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As you already know, [b]Me && MORY[/b] is available.

Thank you for your interest in this new game.

It takes place before [b]LAMBDA end THEORY[/b], and represents a first beginning of the story.
However, [b]Me && MORY[/b] is also very cryptic and many elements are,
like the following game, open to interpretation.

In order to facilitate the understanding and to bring a chronology, all [b]PIXLEAVES[/b] games
will be represented under the name of [b]DATA + STARS Saga[/b].

[h2]DATA + STARS Saga[/h2]

[b]DATA + STARS Saga[/b] is, as its name suggests, a saga of Data and Stars stories,
divided into several volumes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996250/61d6a15b9d69ac96227441b8cd1f41d00992a60a.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32280/DATA__STARS_Saga__Volume_1/]Volume 1[/url] is completed. It includes the following games:
[list]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272640/Me__MORY/]Me && MORY[/url]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1908570/LAMBDA_end_THEORY/]LAMBDA end THEORY[/url][/list]
Thus, you can acquire them in bundle or separately.

In this regard, note that the soundtracks of the games are also available on [b]Steam[/b].

[h2]Future and Volume 2[/h2]

Naturally, work on [b]Volume 2[/b] will begin this year to continue the story.
The next games will be in a different tone and will propose an evolution.
I can't wait to introduce them to you!

Thank you very much for your support!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996250/68c6ec076171b876d7bf8da9356f0cecf02bc978.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996250/189d248160c7a80a1a0d3479fc2f6681a7910fdc.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: LAMBDA end THEORY celebrates its first birthday!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996250/83ff8ca660b3f8817c1cfab47fcc32f2448ce87a.png[/img]

[b]LAMBDA end THEORY[/b] celebrates its first birthday!

Thanks to all those who support the game and have taken the step to play it.

It's a delicate exercise to stand out in the middle of this ocean of other games
and the main goal of [b]LAMBDA end THEORY[/b] is to offer something different and classic.
A real paradox, isn't it?

At [b]PIXLEAVES[/b], the main ambition is to develop symbolic game experiences
that are meaningful and that will reveal their true potential over time.

Universe has its secrets and mysteries... [b]Stardusts[/b], are you ready?

In 2023, a new game will be available: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272640/Me__MORY/][b]Me && MORY[/b][/url].

Thank you so much for your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996250/94e541cde3889b6324635db55d98235dd2a5c78e.png[/img]

notes.title: The Soundtrack is available!
notes.content:
The Soundtrack of [b]LAMBDA end THEORY[/b] is available!

8 synthetic and nostalgic musics are waiting for you
- downloadable in high quality audio.

[i]Synthetic and nostalgic, the soundtrack of [b]LAMBDA end THEORY[/b] is,
like the game, pure and minimalist - it evokes a Past where each note counts
and gives life to a melody of memories.[/i]

You can buy it alone or in bundle with the game
(with a 15% saving on the total price).

Thanks again for your support! <3

Happy Holidays!

-

notes.title: LAMBDA end THEORY is available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for your interest in my game [b]LAMBDA end THEORY[/b].

I'm a French indie developer, deeply in love
with a certain handheld console (released in the 90s).

With [b]PIXLEAVES[/b], I work alone at my vocation:
developing sometimes classic, sometimes atypical, sometimes both, but above all...

...definitely nostalgic video games. Always with heart.

This first project represents the first foundation stone
of an even bigger project, revealing the beginnings of a new common universe
to all my present and future creations.

Thanks to you, a new story has just begun.

[b]LAMBDA end THEORY[/b] is available!

Thank you very much for your support!
